subject: Starter Boost pricing amendment & usage safeguard
messages:
From: Samira Noor <samira@upstartfoundry.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Starter Boost — request for temporary top-up & packaging clarity

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the warm welcome to the Starter Boost cohort — the team and I are excited to get into the sandbox. Quick ask: we have a demo day coming up on July 6 and the event will drive a short burst of traffic (user signups + chat-heavy flows). Our current promo credits will cover steady early usage, but we're worried about the spike on demo day pushing us past the promo cap and creating throttling for customers.

Two questions:
1) Is there an option for a short-term top-up of promotional credits (one-time, non-recurring) to cover the event window?
2) If we do a top-up, can we include a usage safeguard clause so we don't get hit with a surprise bill if usage unexpectedly scales beyond the agreed window? We want to keep the benefit of the promo pricing but avoid a large overage at the end of the month.

Background: we're exploring Dedicated conversion later in H2, but that isn't locked in yet. If a top-up is possible, we'd consider converting credits to a reserved-commit discount if we decide to move to Dedicated within 90 days.

Appreciate any guidance and a rough timeline — signing deadlines are tight.

Thanks,
Samira Noor
Founder & Head of Product
UpStart Foundry

(launchpad-ops@upstartfoundry.com)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Noor <samira@upstartfoundry.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter Boost — request for temporary top-up & packaging clarity

Hi Samira — great to hear and congrats on the demo day invite. Short answer: yes, we can structure a temporary top-up + a usage safeguard; need a couple of internal approvals but we can move quickly. Proposed plan below so you have concrete terms to review: 

Proposed Starter Boost amendment (high level):
- One-time promo top-up: 500,000 tokens (valid for 30 days from invoice/activation) at promo unit rate.
- Usage safeguard: tiered overage protection — if daily token usage exceeds 3x your average baseline during the window, we throttle to promo capacity and automatically notify both teams. Any usage above 5x baseline requires explicit approval to be billed at standard post-promo rates.
- Convertibility: if you convert to Dedicated within 90 days, the unused portion of the top-up can be applied as a credit toward a reserved-capacity discount; conversion terms subject to reserved plan pricing and approval.
- Documentation: we will prepare a one-page amendment (DocuSign) that references the Starter Boost T&Cs and adds the usage safeguard clause and top-up amount.

Next steps I suggest:
1) If the high level above looks ok, reply with "approve in principle" and confirm the demo day window (start/end dates).
2) I will draft an amendment and loop in finance/legal for fast-track signoff — Ben will own pricing approval and Marissa will coordinate the amendment text/ops.
3) We will provide a short cost model and activation timeline; activation can happen within 48 hours of signed amendment.

I attached a one-page template amendment for discussion (starterboost_amendment_draft.pdf).

If you're on a call today I'm happy to walk through the safeguard thresholds.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Starter Boost — pricing suggestion + quick ops notes

Looping finance/legal notes into the thread. My thoughts on the proposed high-level:
- 500k tokens one-time top-up at promo rate — acceptable as an exception for demo/event if we lock the usage safeguard and timebox activation.
- Add an explicit daily cap and clear rollback clause (e.g., after threshhold exceeded X2 three days in a row, auto-disable top-up billing and revert to standard throttles).
- If customer elects Dedicated within 90 days and signs reserved commit, allow a conversion credit equal to unused top-up value but require a minimal 3-month committed spend to avoid revenue leakage.

Marissa — can you draft the short clause language and ops checklist (activation, monitoring alert contact, rollback steps)? I attached a quick cost model to estimate P&L impact (cost_model_v2.xlsx). Irene — accounting treatment: is it ok to treat the top-up as a promo liability with credit conversion path? Need your sign-off on how to record.

If we get internal OK today we can send final amendment back this afternoon.

— Ben
From: Samira Noor <samira@upstartfoundry.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Launchpad Ops <launchpad-ops@upstartfoundry.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter Boost — request for temporary top-up & packaging clarity

Thanks Mina — appreciate the quick turnaround and Ben/Marissa for moving on this.

Approve in principle. Confirming demo day window: July 5 00:00 UTC — July 8 23:59 UTC. The team will accept the 500k token top-up at promo rate with the usage safeguard and the daily cap/rollback language you proposed. We also agree to the conversion path should we decide to move to Dedicated within 90 days (we'll aim to finalize by Sept 15).

Please send the DocuSign amendment and we will sign promptly; also please include the monitoring contact for activation alerts.

Samira Noor
Founder & Head of Product
UpStart Foundry
